integrity: The finite face-poset acyclicity and integer attaching-degree certificate are reproducible using the embedded C++17 and Python 3 sources, and the exact 1,021-order-gradient list. The package includes recorded verification output.
scientific_limitations: The exact homotopy theorem concerns only the full strong discrete-Morse matching complex of the unfilled ten-cycle. It gives neither an all-cycle classification nor an equivariant result. Prior work already determines its integral homology groups. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: A mixed sphere-wedge homotopy type for the full strong Morse complex of the ten-cycle
